title: Against the Push (RoboRally 6×6)
author: Dashiel
rules:
PUZZLE:

Solve in SudokuPad

RULES:

Normal 6×6 sudoku rules apply. Killer cages: digits in a dashed cage sum to the small number and don't repeat. White dot: the two digits are consecutive.

The grid is the robot's program: the 36 digits are executed in reading order (row 1 left to right, then row 2, …).

1 = move 1 forward, 2 = move 2 forward, 3 = back up 1 (without turning), 4 = turn 90° right, 5 = turn 90° left, 6 = U-turn (also shown above the grid).

The robot starts in the top-left cell facing right (blue arrow). After all 36 commands it must stand on the finish (red circle with the checkered flag). It may pass the finish earlier.

After every command the board acts, in this order (also shown right of the grid):

• A conveyor belt moves a robot standing on it one cell in the arrow's direction.

• A pusher pushes a robot standing in front of it one cell away from its wall.

• A robot on a turntable turns 90° left.

• A repeller pushes the first robot in its beam one cell in the beam's direction.

A robot moving or pushed into a wall stays where it is. The robot must never leave the board and must never enter a hole, not even in the middle of a 2-cell move.

INSPIRATION:

The next step after the 4×4 :) I had a clear idea of what I wanted to achieve: a good break-in. I hope you will find it.

This puzzle introduces a new board element, the repeller. Let's see what comes next, there are lots of board elements left to explore.

SERIES:

RoboRally Sudoku series:

• RoboRally Sudoku (4×4)

• Against the Push (RoboRally 6×6) (this puzzle)
solutionCode: Digits of row 6 (left to right), followed by the direction the robot faces at the finish as seen on the image: U (up), D (down), L (left) or R (right). Example: 123456U
